name: SAF System Topology Generator
description: Generate a valid system topology with components and physics-aware connections. Layer 1 of the Physics-Grade SAF system.

variables.name: system_description
variables.label: System Description
variables.placeholder: e.g. Closed loop cooling system with centrifugal pump and heat exchanger

prompt_template:
Generate a complete system topology for a '{{system_description}}' in the '{{domain}}' domain.

Requirements:
1. Select components from the SAF Catalog (Fluid, Mechanical, Thermal).
2. Define ALL connections between components using specific Ports (e.g., 'outlet' -> 'inlet', 'shaft_out' -> 'shaft_in').
3. Ensure domain compatibility (Fluid connects to Fluid, Mechanical to Mechanical).
4. Include spatial layout suggestions (x, y coordinates).

Output strict JSON resembling the MechBlueprint structure.
